apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: New: Calf map (10 min) on the Today screen. Finds each muscle — soleus, medial and lateral gastroc, tibialis posterior, peroneals — right leg first, then left, with a glowing model and where to put your fingers. Rate the left 0–3; scores show in Trends.
Strap hamstring stretch added to Barefoot PT right after lower trunk rotation (2 × 30 s each leg; strap behind the heel on the left). BFR isometric is now the ball press into the wall.
Boot schedule: 20° today (Oct 18), 15° Wed Oct 21, 10° Sat Oct 24, 5° Tue Oct 27, neutral Fri Oct 30. Hinge-day reminders follow it.
